explanation: Lemma 4: the degree-increment extension lemma. Any triangle-free G and vertex v embed as an induced subgraph of a triangle-free H that raises deg v by one and preserves the other degrees of G. This is the standard step behind Theorem 2. Source: Erdős–Fajtlowicz–Staton, 'Degree sequences in triangle-free graphs', Discrete Math. 92 (1991) 85–88. The full text was not accessible; the zbMATH review summary says that triangle-free graphs in which no degree occurs more than twice are bipartite, and that every triangle-free graph is an induced subgraph of one in which no degree occurs more than three times. It could not be checked verbatim against the paper.
